title: 彭博分析师：内地客户占香港新单三至五成，税改影响需谨慎评估
speaker: Stephen Engel

segments.en: So to put things in a perspective, as of now, roughly speaking, you can say mainland customers account for about, say, between 30 to 50%, give or take, right? In terms of the total new business in Hong Kong for life insurance companies.
segments.zh: 从整体来看，目前粗略地说，内地客户约占香港保障类公司新业务总量的30%到50%左右。

segments.en: And this range is very, it's a very wide, you know, some insurance companies like AIA potentials higher on the scale, maybe 50% of that business is from mainland, right? And then a little bit less, for the others, probably a little bit lower, right? But we ran some numbers, so for example, right? If you shave, let's say every 10% off that what they call MCV, mainland Chinese visitor segment, right? The impact on the whole company ranges between two to three percent, right? That's for this year.
segments.zh: 这个范围很宽，比如友邦可能更高，约50%的业务来自内地，其他公司可能略低。但我们测算过，如果内地访客业务每减少10%，对公司整体影响约在2%到3%之间，这是今年的情况。

segments.en: Now of course, the question is, you know, can this apply to existing policies, is it just affecting new policies? Will customers, because of higher friction costs, will surrender the policy and buy stuff in mainland? Right? So we can get to those, but in effect, it is, it is significant, I don't want to water this down too much, let's put it this way, right? We need to be extremely cautious about this.
segments.zh: 当然，问题是这适用于存量保单还是只影响新单？客户是否会因摩擦成本上升而退保并在内地购买？我们可以讨论这些，但影响确实显著，我不想淡化这一点，我们需要非常谨慎。

segments.en: But my personal opinion to that is, buying insurance policy is not a tax evasion, to my knowledge, right? The purpose is not to affect tax. If the argument of putting this tax on offshore insurance policies, then what about the onshore policies? That would be the first question I asked myself, right? At the moment, insurance policies returns or the payout are not tax. That's where we are at right now.
segments.zh: 但我的个人观点是，购买保障产品并非逃税，据我所知，其目的不是影响税收。如果对离岸保障产品征税，那么内地产品呢？这是我首先问自己的问题。目前，保障产品的回报或赔付是不征税的。

segments.en: So we can debate how they, why China is doing this, right? But clearly, you know, we need to look at the facts, right? What can they actually do, and what is actually going to impact, right? Right? Yeah. That is our question. Yeah.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以讨论内地为何这样做，但显然我们需要看事实，他们实际能做什么，实际影响是什么？这正是我们的问题。

segments.en: And we're trying to figure out, because again, they're trying to plug many different loopholes and many different ways. I mean, you're saying it's not tax evasion, but clearly the Chinese authorities want to bridge this yawning budget deficit. They also want to stem what they see to be excessive or illicit cross-border flows.
segments.zh: 我们试图弄清楚，因为他们正在堵住许多不同的漏洞。你说这不是逃税，但显然内地当局希望弥补预算缺口，并遏制他们认为过度的或非法的跨境资金流动。
